scheme_name: Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students
description:
The "Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students" scheme is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India to promote education among differently-abled individuals.

This scheme was introduced in 2006 under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to students with disabilities.

The aim is to encourage them to pursue higher education and vocational training.

The scholarship is intended for students who are pursuing courses from recognized institutions.

The scheme covers various levels of education including undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

Students with disabilities can receive scholarships for professional courses as well.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme varies based on the level of education.

For students pursuing professional courses, the scholarship amount can go up to INR 50,000 per year.

For students in undergraduate courses, the scholarship amount is INR 25,000 per year.

For students in postgraduate courses, the scholarship amount is INR 30,000 per year.

The scheme also provides for additional allowances for students with severe disabilities.

This includes a monthly allowance for books and other educational materials.

The scholarship is available for students with disabilities who have a disability certificate issued by a competent authority.

To be eligible, students must be enrolled in a recognized institution.

The annual income of the family should not exceed INR 6 lakh.

Students must be between the ages of 18 and 30 years to qualify for the scholarship.

The application process involves several steps to ensure that eligible students can apply easily.

Students must fill out the application form available on the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

They need to provide personal details including their name, address, and contact information.

Students must also submit their disability certificate as proof of their eligibility.

Additionally, they must provide proof of admission to the course they are pursuing.

Income proof of the family is also required to ascertain eligibility.

Documents such as salary slips or income tax returns can be submitted as income proof.

Once the application is filled out and all documents are collected, students must submit their application online.

The deadline for submitting applications is usually announced at the beginning of each academic year.

It is crucial for students to keep track of these deadlines to ensure timely submission.

The disbursement of scholarships typically occurs in two installments.

The first installment is usually disbursed at the beginning of the academic year.

The second installment is disbursed after the completion of the first semester.

Students can expect to receive their scholarship amounts directly into their bank accounts.

The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is the primary implementing authority for this scheme.

The department has set up a dedicated helpline for queries related to the scholarship.

Students can reach out to the helpline at 1800 11 2001 for assistance.

The scholarship scheme has seen a significant uptake since its inception.

In the year 2020, over 10,000 students benefited from this scholarship program.

The government has allocated a budget of INR 100 crore for the scheme in the financial year 2022-2023.

This demonstrates the commitment of the government to support differently-abled students.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote inclusive education in India.

The government aims to increase the enrollment of differently-abled students in higher education institutions.

The scholarship program is designed to reduce the financial burden on families of differently-abled students.

It also aims to empower these students by providing them with the means to pursue their educational aspirations.

The scheme has been well-received by various stakeholders including educational institutions and NGOs.

Feedback from beneficiaries has highlighted the positive impact of the scholarship on their educational journeys.

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the scheme.

This ensures that it meets the needs of differently-abled students across the country.

The scholarship program is also aligned with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

This act emphasizes the right to education for all individuals, including those with disabilities.

The scholarship scheme is a step towards fulfilling this commitment.

The government encourages educational institutions to promote awareness about this scholarship.

This helps ensure that eligible students are informed about the benefits available to them.

The scheme also aims to foster a more inclusive society by supporting the education of differently-abled individuals.

In conclusion, the "Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students" scheme is a vital initiative.

It provides essential financial support to help differently-abled students pursue their educational goals.

With specific eligibility criteria and a structured application process, the scheme aims to empower students.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme can significantly alleviate the economic burden on families.

This initiative reflects the government's commitment to promoting inclusivity and equal opportunities for all individuals.
